description: This file defines the WhileBlock class which extends the Block class, representing a 'while' loop construct in the SCSSPHP compiler. It contains a property for conditions and sets its type in the constructor.

classes.name: WhileBlock
classes.description: Represents a 'while' loop block within the SCSSPHP parser, characterized by its condition array and setting its type to T_WHILE.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a WhileBlock instance and sets its type to T_WHILE.
